## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it clearly.
_e.g. "It's frustrating that I have to manually edit config to switch RPC endpoints..."_

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Approaches Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Implementation Notes (optional)

If you have a suggested approach — specific files, APIs, or patterns to follow — add them here. This helps maintainers scope the work and helps new contributors pick it up as a `good first issue`.

```
e.g. Add a --rpc flag to packages/cli/src/commands/deploy.ts
     and wire it through to the existing RPC fallback list in deploy.ts
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Additional Context

Screenshots, links to related issues, or relevant prior art.
